description: The React Suspended vulnerable application to XSS attacks

vulnerabilities.description: Unsanitized input from a React useState value flows into a React dynamic 'href' attribute, where it is used to dynamically construct the HTML page on client side. This may result in a DOM Based Cross-Site Scripting attack (DOMXSS)
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: User controlled twitter link flows into a React JSX element in href attribute where it is rendered as an anchor tag without proper sanitzation or value double quotes enclosure

vulnerabilities.description: The authorScreenshotURL is not properly sanitized and flows into a React JSX element in src attribute where it is rendered as an image tag without proper sanitzation or value double quotes enclosure
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: When users can control JSX elememnts that are rendered with a dangerouslySetInnerHTML and the JSX element is not properly using double quotes for the attribute value enclosure then values can escape the attribute boundary and be interpreted as a new element attribute
